title: Hoge Finance
tagline: Hoge Finance explores ways to empower the DeFi space through utilities, education, and software development.
description: Uniswap ERC-20 Token Chipper.  Tokens are sent to the chipper contract and a uniswap price oracle is used to get the price of the tokens,  the token price determines the complexity of the spline image generation.  We initially thought of this concept as a way to get rid of air-dropped "dust" tokens in an erc wallet.
how_its_made: We used solidity for the contract programming, python for the spline images, and react with moralis web3 sdk for the front-end.  The solidity includes logic for the chipper and the uniswap price oracle.  The docker container contains the python code to generate the spline images based on the cost of the tokens burned in the chipper contract.
